comparison.objective: Position crane outrigger pads, versus tune and lock a compact damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Handle and align load-spreading pads under outriggers versus recessed hex-key engagement, fine collar rotation, bimanual counterholding, and bounded tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Correct pad placement is title-implied; no body/specs, support-area, alignment, or load rubric is available. Candidate requires measured safe carriage stops and no drift.
comparison.reason: Support-pad positioning does not test adjustable damping behavior or retention under witness torque.
